# Exploration, Realms and the Town Guide

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_exploration_guide.py; edit exploration/rules.json and language inputs. -->

Suggested route: settle as a mortal, explore the Overworld in Qi Refining, venture into the Nether in Foundation, then prepare for the End in Golden Core. Early entry is allowed by default; gear, potions, terrain and skill still matter. Administrators can opt into native portal gates.

These are baseline recommendations. Higher-realm Overworld regions raise local structure advice, ordinary encounters and cultivation rewards.

## Town Guide

An existing local resident becomes the guide in Yunshan’s inn reception area, on duty by day and resting at night. Right-click for your next step, then use the chat link for more tips. Advice reads each player’s realm, initiation and vanilla advancements separately.

`/exploration` shows your current location, `/exploration guide` your next step, `/exploration guide tips` another tip, `/exploration guide side` optional boss branches, `/exploration guide where` the assigned guide’s position, and `/exploration catalogue` all baseline advice. Available without operator permission.

The role remains vacant if local candidates or observed facilities are unavailable; no new person is fabricated.

## Main Route

- **Use a Spirit Testing Stele to awaken your spiritual root.** (Mortal)
  - The Spirit Testing Stele opens awakening; it does not teach a core technique.
  - Set a bed, carry food and light your shelter before long trips.
- **Receive Basic Breathing at a Technique Inheritance Stele.** (Mortal)
  - Basic Breathing lets you begin the cultivation loop.
  - Use the cultivation panel to accumulate progress, then consolidate stability.
- **Reach Qi Refining 4 and obtain iron. Explore nearby mines and gather forging materials.** (Qi Refining 4)
  - Deep caves supply dark iron; riverbanks supply edge-tempering sand.
  - Use a pattern book to learn it permanently, then forge at a ding.
- **Reach Qi Refining 7; try normal trials and prepare medicines.** (Qi Refining 7)
  - Normal trials are advised at Qi Refining 7–9; ominous trials at middle–late Foundation.
  - Learn a formula once; herbs from exploration can be planted and harvested.
- **Consolidate stability and advance to early Foundation before a sustained Nether expedition.** (Foundation Establishment · Early)
  - Full cultivation progress alone is not enough; stability must also meet the advancement requirement.
  - Portals are unrestricted by default; server owners can opt into realm gates. Fire resistance still matters.
- **Prepare fire resistance, gold gear and return coordinates, then enter the Nether.** (Foundation Establishment · Early)
  - Realm health does not grant lava or fire immunity.
  - Gold equipment helps with ordinary piglins; do not rely on it against brutes.
- **Find a Nether fortress and obtain a blaze rod. Early–middle Foundation is advised.** (Foundation Establishment · Early)
  - Block wither skeleton approaches and establish cover before fighting blazes.
  - Craft one spirit copper ingot from a copper ingot, blaze powder and a low-grade spirit stone. Qi infusion remains an alternative.
- **Craft eyes of ender and locate a stronghold. Prepare a safe return route.** (Foundation Establishment · Early)
  - Eyes of ender combine ender pearls and blaze powder; keep extras for the portal.
  - Write down your portal coordinates and protect the route.
- **Advance to early Golden Core before your first End expedition.** (Golden Core · Early)
  - Golden Core is the proposed End stage; improve gear and arts alongside realm.
  - Void falls remain lethal regardless of realm.
- **Prepare for the dragon: destroy its crystals before fighting the body, then explore the outer islands through a gateway.** (Golden Core · Early)
  - Crystals heal the dragon. Deal with crystals and cages first; perched and flying phases have different hit conditions.
  - Bring blocks and an escape plan for levitation and void edges.
  - A flying sword helps with controlled ascent and viewing crystals. Existing combat moves are unavailable while mounted; plan crystal removal and ground attacks separately.
- **Use an End gateway to reach the outer islands; bring blocks, pearls and a safe return plan.** (Golden Core · Early)
  - Enter gateways with pearls or a suitable approach. Record landing and return points, and keep spare pearls.
  - Bring blocks and an escape plan for levitation and void edges.
- **Find an End city, deal with shulkers carefully and secure your footing before looting.** (Golden Core · Middle)
  - Shulkers cause levitation. Bring slow falling, pearls and cover; secure your landing before engaging elevated targets.
  - Shells and a chest make a shulker box. Portable storage and finite city chests reward exploration; opened chests do not refill.
- **Find a city with an End ship, retrieve an elytra, and prepare fireworks and repairs.** (Golden Core · Middle)
  - Only cities with an End ship offer an elytra. Clear nearby shulkers before taking it and keep return supplies.
  - Elytra offer unmounted long-distance gliding and firework boosts. Prepare durability, rockets and landing sites; controlled sword ascent serves a different purpose.

## Optional Boss Branches

These branches do not gate the main route. Killing a warden is never required for End progress; ancient cities can be looted stealthily with a planned retreat.

- **Elder guardian** — Foundation Establishment · Middle
  - Monuments are optional. Clear guardians and open a retreat before handling elder beams and thorns; avoid being surrounded underwater.
  - Water breathing and night vision help underwater. Milk removes mining fatigue and your other potion effects, so prepare another breathing potion.
- **Wither** — Golden Core · Middle
  - Before summoning, clear important buildings and allies from the area. Bring sustained healing, ranged and close attacks, and supplies against the wither effect.
  - The summoning blast precedes the fight; attack eligibility changes at low health. Use a separate arena with an exit, away from towns.
- **Direct warden challenge (optional)** — Golden Core · Late
  - A direct warden fight is optional and never blocks the guide route. Sneak for loot, use wool to control sound and retreat promptly.
  - Warden sonic attacks pass through walls. Armor does not replace distance and an escape plan; a cramped shelter is not a safe zone.

## Optional Portal Gates

Gates are disabled by default. When enabled, realm checks apply only to players entering the Nether or End through native dimension portals. Returning to the Overworld, same-dimension travel, administrator teleport commands and non-player entities keep their original behavior.

Enabled in this configuration: false

- Nether: Foundation Establishment · Early
- End: Golden Core · Early

Server owners can set `[portal_gates] enabled = true` in the instance’s `config/myvillage-exploration-server.toml`. An existing file of the same name in `<world>/serverconfig/` takes precedence for that world; create it manually for a world-specific override. A matching `defaultconfigs/` file initializes a missing base configuration; it does not automatically create an override for each new world. Realm thresholds remain owned by the rules JSON.

## Overworld

- **Overworld surface：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Establish shelter, food and tools. Local monsters follow the regional realm.
- **Caves and deep mining：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 5** — Bring light, a shield and a retreat route; deep caves contain dark iron.
- **Lush caves：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 4** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Dripstone caves：Qi Refining 2 – Qi Refining 5** — Watch ledges and dripstone. Realm does not remove fall damage.
- **Ocean exploration：Mortal – Qi Refining 5** — Prepare air, visibility and a way back. Health cannot replace oxygen.
- **Village：Mortal – Qi Refining 2** — Trade and resupply. Protect villagers and avoid an unprepared raid.
- **Ruined portal：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Buried treasure：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Trail ruins：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring a brush and avoid breaking suspicious blocks.
- **Igloo：Mortal – Qi Refining 3** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Shipwreck：Mortal – Qi Refining 4** — Check your air and exit before searching the hold.
- **Ocean ruins：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Prepare air and watch drowned; their tridents scale with their realm.
- **Desert pyramid：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Inspect pressure plates and TNT. Realm advice does not make traps safe.
- **Jungle temple：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Look for tripwires and dispensers before opening chests.
- **Swamp hut：Qi Refining 3 – Qi Refining 6** — Prepare for potion effects rather than relying only on health.
- **Mineshaft：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 4** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Monster room：Qi Refining 1 – Qi Refining 4** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Pillager outpost and patrol：Qi Refining 4 – Qi Refining 7** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Woodland mansion：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Prepare for evokers, vexes and axe attacks; avoid pulling several rooms.
- **Stronghold：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Bring eyes of ender and an exit. The End is advised at early Golden Core; boss tuning follows later.
- **Trial chamber：Qi Refining 7 – Qi Refining 9** — Complete a normal trial first. An ominous bottle deliberately raises the challenge.
- **Ominous trial：Foundation Establishment · Middle – Foundation Establishment · Late** — Ominous spawners use a separate realm band. Bring supplies and an exit.
- **Raid：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Protect villagers. Raiders retain their birth realm when moved.
- **Ocean monument：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Bring water breathing, night vision, milk and an underwater exit. Elder guardians are optional; use /exploration guide side.
- **Deep dark：Qi Refining 7 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Avoid repeated shrieker activations. Sneaking, wool and an exit are safer than a direct fight.
- **Ancient city：Qi Refining 7 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Sneak, use wool and keep an escape route. Killing a warden is not required for exploration or the main route.

## Nether

- **Nether wastes and forests：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Early Foundation advised. Bring fire resistance, gold gear and return coordinates; lava remains dangerous.
- **Soul sand valley and basalt deltas：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Watch ranged attacks, slowing ground and lava drops; establish a safe route.
- **Nether landmark：Qi Refining 9 – Foundation Establishment · Early** — Bring light and keep a retreat route.
- **Nether fortress：Foundation Establishment · Early – Foundation Establishment · Middle** — Bring fire resistance and watch wither skeletons. Blaze powder, copper and spirit stone craft spirit copper.
- **Bastion remnant：Foundation Establishment · Middle – Foundation Establishment · Late** — Piglin brutes are dangerous. Prepare for late Foundation in treasure areas; stealth remains useful.

## End

- **End islands：Golden Core · Early – Golden Core · Middle** — Ordinary island endermen use an independent End band. Bring ranged tools, supplies and safe footing before destroying crystals; the void remains lethal.
- **End outer islands：Golden Core · Early – Golden Core · Middle** — Bring pearls, blocks and return coordinates. Outer-island mobs do not inherit Overworld region bands; avoid staring at endermen.
- **End city and ship：Golden Core · Middle – Golden Core · Late** — Plan cover, safe landings and protection against levitation and falls. End ships retain their elytra value.

## Exploration Rewards

Selected vanilla chests and normal/ominous vaults append bounded cultivation supplies alongside vanilla loot, scaled to local risk. Mob drops, repeatable spawner payouts and villager trades do not receive this bonus. Previously opened chests are not refilled.

Blaze powder + a common copper ingot + a low-grade spirit stone craft one spirit copper ingot for channeling forging. Qi infusion at the ding remains an alternative.

End cities append existing cultivation supplies and usable manuals only to finite native chests. Shulker boxes, dragon breath and ship elytra retain their native value. V2 defines independent profiles for the dragon, wither, warden and elder guardian; vanilla mitigation still runs once.
